Sending the right snapshot context with each write is required for
snapshots to work. Due to the ordering of calls
is never set for any requests. This causes writes to the current
version of the image to be reflected in all snapshots
This happens because rbd_osd_req_format_write() sets the snapshot
context based on obj_request->img_request. At this point
obj_request->img_request has not been set yet
is set to NULL. Fix this by moving rbd_img_obj_request_add()
